verses.original: הַ֭יַּין לֵ֣ץ שֵׁכָ֑ר הֹמֶ֣ה וְכָל־ שֹׁ֥גֶה בּ֝֗וֹ לֹ֣א יֶחְכָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yayn lêṣ šê·ḵār hō·meh wə·ḵāl šō·ḡeh bōw lō yeḥ·kām
verses.literal: Wine is a mocker strong drink is a brawler and whoever is led astray by them is not wise

verses.original: אֵ֣ימַת מֶ֑לֶךְ נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר מִ֝תְעַבְּר֗וֹ חוֹטֵ֥א נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·maṯ me·leḵ na·ham kak·kə·p̄îr miṯ·‘ab·bə·rōw ḥō·w·ṭê nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: The terror of a king is like the roar of a lion whoever provokes [him] forfeits his own life

verses.original: כָּב֣וֹד לָ֭אִישׁ שֶׁ֣בֶת מֵרִ֑יב וְכָל־ אֱ֝וִ֗יל יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃
verses.transliteration: kā·ḇō·wḏ lā·’îš še·ḇeṯ mê·rîḇ wə·ḵāl ’ĕ·wîl yiṯ·gal·lā‘
verses.literal: It is honorable for a man to resolve a dispute but any fool will quarrel

verses.original: עָצֵ֣ל לֹא־ יַחֲרֹ֑שׁ מֵ֭חֹרֶף בַּקָּצִ֣יר יִשְׁאַל וָאָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ṣêl lō- ya·ḥă·rōš mê·ḥō·rep̄ baq·qā·ṣîr yiš·ʾal wā·’ā·yin
verses.literal: The slacker does not plow in season at harvest time he looks but nothing is there

verses.original: עֵצָ֣ה אִ֑ישׁ בְלֶב־ עֲ֭מֻקִּים מַ֣יִם וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנָ֣ה יִדְלֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·ṣāh ’îš ḇə·leḇ- ‘ă·muq·qîm ma·yim wə·’îš tə·ḇū·nāh yiḏ·len·nāh
verses.literal: The intentions of a man’s heart are deep waters but a man of understanding draws them out

verses.original: רָב־ אָדָ֗ם יִ֭קְרָא אִ֣ישׁ חַסְדּ֑וֹ מִ֣י יִמְצָֽא׃ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים וְאִ֥ישׁ
verses.transliteration: rāḇ- ’ā·ḏām yiq·rā ’îš ḥas·dōw mî yim·ṣā ’ĕ·mū·nîm wə·’îš
verses.literal: Many a man proclaims his loving devotion but who can find a trustworthy man

verses.original: צַדִּ֑יק מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֣וֹ אַשְׁרֵ֖י בָנָ֣יו אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq miṯ·hal·lêḵ bə·ṯum·mōw ’aš·rê ḇā·nāw ’a·ḥă·rāw
verses.literal: The righteous man walks with integrity blessed [are] his children after him

verses.original: מֶ֗לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־ כִּסֵּא־ דִ֑ין מְזָרֶ֖ה כָּל־ רָֽע׃ בְעֵינָ֣יו
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ yō·wō·šêḇ ‘al- kis·sê- ḏîn mə·zā·reh kāl- rā‘ ḇə·‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: A king who sits on a throne to judge sifts out all evil with his eyes

verses.original: מִֽי־ יֹ֭אמַר לִבִּ֑י זִכִּ֣יתִי טָ֝הַ֗רְתִּי מֵחַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yō·mar lib·bî zik·kî·ṯî ṭā·har·tî mê·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî
verses.literal: Who can say I have kept my heart pure I am cleansed from my sin

verses.original: אֶ֣בֶן וָ֭אֶבֶן אֵיפָ֣ה וְאֵיפָ֑ה שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃ תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם־
verses.transliteration: ’e·ḇen wā·’e·ḇen ’ê·p̄āh wə·’ê·p̄āh šə·nê·hem tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh gam-
verses.literal: Differing weights and unequal measures . . . both are detestable to the LORD . . .

verses.original: גַּ֣ם נָ֑עַר יִתְנַכֶּר־ בְּ֭מַעֲלָלָיו אִם־ פָּעֳלֽוֹ׃ זַ֖ךְ וְאִם־ יָשָׁ֣ר
verses.transliteration: gam nā·‘ar yiṯ·nak·ker- bə·ma·‘ă·lā·lāw ’im- pā·‘o·lōw zaḵ wə·’im- yā·šār
verses.literal: Even a young man is known by his actions whether his conduct is pure . . . and upright

verses.original: אֹ֣זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת וְעַ֣יִן רֹאָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה גַם־ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·zen šō·mēr wə·‘a·yin rō·’āh Yah·weh ‘ā·śāh ḡam- šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: Ears that hear and eyes that see the LORD has made them . . . both

verses.original: אַל־ תֶּֽאֱהַ֣ב שֵׁ֭נָה פֶּן־ תִּוָּרֵ֑שׁ פְּקַ֖ח עֵינֶ֣יךָ שְֽׂבַֽע־ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- te·’ĕ·haḇ šē·nāh pen- tiw·wā·rêš pə·qaḥ ‘ê·ne·ḵā śə·ḇa‘- lā·ḥem
verses.literal: Do not love sleep or you will grow poor open your eyes [and] you will have plenty of food

verses.original: רַ֣ע רַ֭ע יֹאמַ֣ר הַקּוֹנֶ֑ה וְאֹזֵ֥ל ל֝֗וֹ אָ֣ז יִתְהַלָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ra‘ ra‘ yō·mar haq·qō·w·neh wə·’ō·zêl lōw ’āz yiṯ·hal·lāl
verses.literal: Worthless worthless says the buyer but on the way out - he gloats

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ וְרָב־ זָ֭הָב פְּנִינִ֑ים שִׂפְתֵי־ דָֽעַת׃ יְ֝קָ֗ר וּכְלִ֥י
verses.transliteration: yêš wə·rāḇ- zā·hāḇ pə·nî·nîm śip̄·ṯê- ḏā·‘aṯ yə·qār ū·ḵə·lî
verses.literal: There is an abundance of gold [and] rubies but lips of knowledge are a rare treasure

verses.original: לְֽקַח־ בִּ֭גְדוֹ כִּי־ עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר חַבְלֵֽהוּ׃ וּבְעַ֖ד נָכְרִים
verses.transliteration: lə·qaḥ- biḡ·ḏōw kî- ‘ā·raḇ zār ḥaḇ·lê·hū ū·ḇə·‘aḏ nå̄·ḵə·rīm
verses.literal: Take the garment of the one who posts security for a stranger get collateral if it is for a foreigner

verses.original: לֶ֣חֶם שָׁ֑קֶר עָרֵ֣ב לָ֭אִישׁ וְ֝אַחַ֗ר פִ֥יהוּ יִמָּֽלֵא־ חָצָֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: le·ḥem šā·qer ‘ā·rêḇ lā·’îš wə·’a·ḥar p̄î·hū yim·mā·lê- ḥā·ṣāṣ
verses.literal: Food gained by fraud is sweet to a man but later his mouth is full of gravel

verses.original: תִכּ֑וֹן מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּעֵצָ֣ה עֲשֵׂ֣ה מִלְחָמָֽה׃ וּ֝בְתַחְבֻּל֗וֹת
verses.transliteration: ṯik·kō·wn ma·ḥă·šā·ḇō·wṯ bə·‘ê·ṣāh ‘ă·śêh mil·ḥā·māh ū·ḇə·ṯaḥ·bu·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Set plans by consultation and wage war under sound guidance

verses.original: גּֽוֹלֶה־ סּ֭וֹד הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָכִ֑יל לֹ֣א תִתְעָרָֽב׃ וּלְפֹתֶ֥ה שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו
verses.transliteration: gō·w·leh- sō·wḏ hō·w·lêḵ rā·ḵîl lō ṯiṯ·‘ā·rāḇ ū·lə·p̄ō·ṯeh śə·p̲ā·t̲āyw
verses.literal: He who reveals secrets is a constant gossip vvv avoid the one who babbles with his lips

verses.original: מְ֭קַלֵּל אָבִ֣יו וְאִמּ֑וֹ נֵ֝ר֗וֹ יִֽדְעַ֥ךְ בְּאִישׁוֹן חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·qal·lêl ’ā·ḇîw wə·’im·mōw nê·rōw yiḏ·‘aḵ bə·ʾī·šōn ḥō·šeḵ
verses.literal: Whoever curses his father or mother his lamp will be extinguished in deepest darkness

verses.original: נַ֭חֲלָה מְבֻחֶלֶת בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֑ה לֹ֣א תְבֹרָֽךְ׃ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ
verses.transliteration: na·ḥă·lāh mə·ḇu·ḥɛ·lɛṯ bā·ri·šō·nāh lō ṯə·ḇō·rāḵ wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯāh
verses.literal: An inheritance gained quickly will not be blessed in the end

verses.original: אַל־ תֹּאמַ֥ר אֲשַׁלְּמָה־ רָ֑ע קַוֵּ֥ה לַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה וְיֹ֣שַֽׁע לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tō·mar ’ă·šal·lə·māh- rā‘ qaw·wêh Yah·weh wə·yō·ša‘ lāḵ
verses.literal: Do not say I will avenge this evil Wait on the LORD and He will save you

verses.original: אֶ֣בֶן וָאָ֑בֶן תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מִרְמָ֣ה וּמֹאזְנֵ֖י לֹא־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·ḇen wā·’ā·ḇen tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh mir·māh ū·mō·zə·nê lō- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Unequal weights . . . are detestable to the LORD and dishonest scales are no good

verses.original: גָ֑בֶר מִצְעֲדֵי־ מֵיהוָ֥ה מַה־ וְ֝אָדָ֗ם יָּבִ֥ין דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ḡā·ḇer miṣ·‘ă·ḏê- mē·h·wå̄h mah- wə·’ā·ḏām yā·ḇîn dar·kōw
verses.literal: A man’s steps [are] from the LORD so how can anyone understand his own way

verses.original: מוֹקֵ֣שׁ אָ֭דָם קֹ֑דֶשׁ יָ֣לַע וְאַחַ֖ר לְבַקֵּֽר׃ נְדָרִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: mō·w·qêš ’ā·ḏām qō·ḏeš yā·la‘ wə·’a·ḥar lə·ḇaq·qêr nə·ḏā·rîm
verses.literal: It is a trap for a man to dedicate something rashly only later to reconsider his vows

verses.original: חָכָ֑ם מֶ֣לֶךְ מְזָרֶ֣ה רְ֭שָׁעִים וַיָּ֖שֶׁב אוֹפָֽן׃ עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḵām me·leḵ mə·zā·reh rə·šā·‘îm way·yā·šeḇ ’ō·w·p̄ān ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: A wise king separates out the wicked and drives the threshing wheel over them

verses.original: נִשְׁמַ֣ת אָדָ֑ם נֵ֣ר יְ֭הוָה חֹ֝פֵ֗שׂ כָּל־ חַדְרֵי־ בָֽטֶן׃
verses.transliteration: niš·maṯ ’ā·ḏām nêr Yah·weh ḥō·p̄êś kāl- ḥaḏ·rê- ḇā·ṭen
verses.literal: The spirit of a man [is] the lamp of the LORD searching out . . . his inmost being . . .

verses.original: חֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יִצְּרוּ־ מֶ֑לֶךְ בַּחֶ֣סֶד וְסָעַ֖ד כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ yiṣ·ṣə·rū- me·leḵ ba·ḥe·seḏ wə·sā·‘aḏ kis·’ōw
verses.literal: Loving devotion and faithfulness preserve a king by these he maintains his throne

verses.original: תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בַּחוּרִ֣ים כֹּחָ֑ם שֵׂיבָֽה׃ וַהֲדַ֖ר זְקֵנִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: tip̄·’e·reṯ ba·ḥū·rîm kō·ḥām śê·ḇāh wa·hă·ḏar zə·qê·nîm
verses.literal: The glory of young men is their strength and gray hair is the splendor of the old

verses.original: חַבֻּר֣וֹת פֶּ֭צַע תַּמְרִיק בְּרָ֑ע וּ֝מַכּ֗וֹת חַדְרֵי־ בָֽטֶן׃
verses.transliteration: ḥab·bu·rō·wṯ pe·ṣa‘ tam·rīq bə·rā‘ ū·mak·kō·wṯ ḥaḏ·rê- ḇā·ṭen
verses.literal: Lashes and wounds scour evil and beatings cleanse the inmost parts . . .
